name: write-file
description: Create a new file or overwrite an existing file with the given content. Parent directories are created automatically. Use this instead of shell redirection (echo > file) for writing files — content is passed verbatim with no quoting or encoding surprises.

path.description: Path to the file to create or overwrite (absolute or relative). Parent directories are created automatically.

content.description: Full content to write to the file. May be empty to create a blank file.
